acceptance_checks.detail: Original AutoSci native skill document exists.
Solar feature parity route declares a backend action.

Native /research defines a resumable Stage 0-5 pipeline with two human gates, progress/report artifacts, stage recovery, experiment deploy/collect, verdict, and paper-writing stages delegated to sub-skills.
The proof run wrote pipeline progress, pipeline report, and machine-readable pipeline state artifacts, and the workflow evidence records a completed pipeline status and completed current stage.

Supplied local source paper, completed literature_discovery.v1, and completed external_novelty.v1 evidence satisfy the non-remote source/discovery/novelty stages without claiming live provider freshness.
Completed Review LLM evidence is attached and produces a runtime proof manifest with review_llm_or_model_evidence plus external_runtime_evidence categories.
The approval contract verifies allowlist, before, after, and runtime evidence; experiment runtime semantic verification is verified, including successful exit and result_collected=true.
The compile runtime evidence verifies compile success, structurally valid PDF output, and integrated PDF materialization to the Solar workspace paper path.
The route retains generic scheduler and legacy smoke runner boundaries, but this proof does not claim distributed scheduler lease/quota/runtime audit, remote sessions, or production dispatch.

Regression coverage preserves inconclusive behavior when stage evidence, scheduler lifecycle summaries, workflow config alignment, production dispatch, Review LLM evidence, experiment runtime, or compile/PDF evidence is missing or weak.

findings.finding: The non-remote supplied-evidence $research lifecycle path now has route-level semantic proof and worktree-local runtime proof manifests for source, Review LLM, and approved runtime/approval evidence.

This audit does not claim fresh live provider fetches, automatic bootstrap network search, remote/session stage runners, distributed scheduler lease/quota behavior, SMTP/browser side effects, or unapproved sub-skill execution.
The top-level skill-run summary remains inconclusive while static route coverage is partial/approval-gated; action-level workflow_evolution evidence is completed and passed.

The proof attempted to isolate outputs with --wiki-root, but pipeline progress/report/state were still written to the default Solar workspace outputs; those paths are retained as proof refs and logged for future cleanup.

limitations: Evidence-aware lifecycle completion is supported when wiki/source, Review LLM, experiment runtime, collection, and compile/PDF evidence are supplied.

`$research --scheduler-run` now defaults to `run_scientific_workflow.py`, a config-driven generic workflow runner that dispatches selected workflow nodes through operator_runtime and records `runner_contract=generic_workflow_runner`; the old bounded lifecycle smoke runner remains available only through `--scheduler-legacy-smoke-runner`.

Scheduler resume runs on the legacy smoke path still emit `autosci_scheduler_resume_boundary.v1` with reused-node fingerprints and no-rerun checks; generic workflow lifecycle summaries emit `scientific_workflow_runtime_manifest.v1`, but production scheduler parity still requires complete non-fixture node selection plus distributed lease/quota/runtime audit.

`--scheduler-require-workflow-config-alignment` passes only for the full supplied-evidence tail; partial/default runs surface workflow_config_alignment drift or inconclusive status rather than full parity.
`--scheduler-require-production-dispatch` now fails when the selected scheduler runner reports fixture/smoke input markers or blocked provider/runtime evidence.

`--scheduler-include-human-gates` records idea/results approval pauses as scheduler-visible blocked nodes, `--online` can carry supplied approval/runtime source evidence into strict scheduler source mode with non-fixture provider channel boundary checks, scheduler experiment stages can carry explicit `--experiment-*` approval/runtime evidence without reusing source evidence paths, `--experiment-execute-approved` can run an allowlisted approved local experiment command, and scheduler publication compile can use compile-specific approved runtime evidence or `--compile-execute-approved`.
Full parity still requires real provider evidence, audited remote/session stage runners, production scheduler dispatch, and submission/anonymity checks.

summary: Solar $research preserves the non-remote supplied-evidence lifecycle completion path of native /research: it records resumable pipeline progress/report/state, verifies source/discovery/novelty evidence, consumes completed Review LLM evidence, verifies approved experiment runtime and collection evidence, verifies approved compile/PDF evidence, materializes an integrated paper PDF, and marks every lifecycle stage completed. This scoped audit does not claim live provider freshness, automatic bootstrap network fetch, distributed scheduler lease/quota behavior, remote/session stage runners, SMTP/browser side effects, or actual unapproved sub-skill execution.
